theorem moduleCup_flasque_acyclicity (X : Scheme.{u})
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    [TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj F)] (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj F)

title: Module-valued flasque acyclicity
statement: Let X be a scheme and F a module sheaf whose underlying abelian sheaf is flasque. For every natural q > 0, H^q(X,F) is a zero module.

source.place: Flasque acyclicity, together with module/abelian cohomology comparison Tag 03FD

proof.text: Obtain the module/underlying-abelian cohomology isomorphism from module_cohomology_iso_underlying_abelian. Apply IsFlasque.subsingleton_H'_top in positive degree to the underlying sheaf. Transport subsingletonness along the injective additive equivalence supplied by the isomorphism. ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton gives the asserted zero module.
